titles.title: Untitled (Abstraction Green Lines and Red Circle)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Uneven vertical green strokes are set towards the center of the paper in two separate columns that are suspended on the paper. The green columns are separated by empty space and joined only by a red circle 1/3 of the way from the top of the paper. Faint, horizontal, graphite lines are visible across the image.
